newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept GDP up 9.6 percent --official.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept GDP up 9.6 percent --official.

text.p: China's gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 9.6 percent in the first nine months of 1996, the State Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
GDP was 4.5675 trillion yuan ($550.3 billion) between January and September, or up 9.6 percent from a year ago, the bureau said. It gave no further details.
China's GDP grew by 10.2 percent in 1995.
Officials have said they want to curb economic growth below 10 percent this year to keep the economy from overheating.
